Badiuzzaman and others ------ Preemptee-Opposite Parties
full_judgment: 10. We have come across from the original case record that the pre-emptors in support of their respective case adduced four witnesses. The witness No.1 is Kazi Moslem Uddin, who is a moharar of Pangsha sub-registry office. This witness is a formal witness, who has proved the registration of the deed and its entry in the volume book. The witness No.2 Rabindranath Das is a mohorar of Faridpur District Register's record room. This witness also brought a volume book in support of proving a deed being No. 482 of the year 1965. The witness No.3 is Krishna Gopal Sikder, who is the pre-emptor No.2 of the case. The last witness for the pre-emptors is Subroto Biswas, who states in his deposition that for the first time they - were in the know about the transfer on 20.05.1995 when the opposite party Nos. l and 2 claimed partition in the case jots. Vis-a-vis the witness No.1 of the pre-emptees is Maniruzzaman, who is the purchaser-opposite party No.2. This witness specifically states in his deposition that the vendor Anil Kumar Shil prior to their purchase of the land made a proposal to the pre-emptor-petitioners but the pre-emptors stating their inadequacy of money refused to purchase the case land. The witness further states that the petitioner Krishna Gopal thereafter called them to purchase the land and the talk of sale was held in the residence of Bishnupada At the time of fixation of consideration amount the preemptor-petitioners were also present and the remained present at the time of delivery of possession of the land. The witness No. 2 of the opposite-party is Anil Kumar Shil, who is the vendor of the case kabla. This witness specifically states that prior to the pre-emptees he proposed to sale the case land in favour of Bishnupada and Krishnapada, but they refused to purchase the same and they themselves managed the pre-emptee-opposite party Nos. 1 and 2 to purchase the property. At the time of talk of sale the pre-emptor Nos. I and 2 along with others were present. At that time beside Bishnu and Krishna one Abd1 Majid and Baku Master were present. The witness No.3 of the pre-emptees is Md. Abu Bakkar Siddique @ Baku Master. This witness corroborated the witness No.2 as regard his presence and presence of the pre-emptors at the time of talk of sale. This witness also corroborated the pre-emptees that the seller of the deed prior to the pre-emptees proposed the pre-emptors to purchase the land, but they refused and at their refusal the pre-emptee-opposite party Nos. I and 2 agreed to purchase the case land. The witness No. 4 is Abdul Mazid, who was present at the time of talk of sale and corroborated the witness Nos. I, 2 and 3 of the pre-emptees in respect of giving proposal to purchase the land in favour of Krishna and Bishnu the petitioner Nos. 1 and 2 and their expression of refusal to purchase the land and presence at the time of talk of sale. The last witness is Abdul Mazid Master, who is the Ex-Chairman of Pangsha Municipality. This witness specifically states in his deposition about his presence at the time of delivery of possession of the case land. He also states in the last part of February, 1995 A.D. the possession was delivered in favour of purchaser-opposite parties and at that time the petitioners were present.
